tools.name: get_docs
tools.description: Quickstart for the Usage Lab metering API and this MCP server: how to get a free API key, connect, create a meter, record idempotent usage events and read rollups. No API key needed.

tools.name: list_meters
tools.description: List the meters on your Usage Lab account (key, name, aggregation sum | count | unique_count). Needs your API key (Authorization: Bearer).

tools.name: create_meter
tools.description: Create a meter once (POST /api/v1/meters). aggregation: sum (add up value, e.g. tokens), count (number of events, e.g. tool calls) or unique_count (distinct unique_value, e.g. active users). Re-creating an existing key returns meter_exists (harmless). Free plan: 3 meters. Needs your API key.

tools.name: record_usage_events
tools.description: Record 1-100 usage events in one all-or-nothing batch (POST /api/v1/usage). Every event MUST carry its own idempotency_key; retrying with the same keys is safe (results say created / duplicate / conflict). Needs your API key.

tools.name: get_meter_rollups
tools.description: Monthly totals per customer for one meter, recomputed from raw events (GET /api/v1/meters/{meter}/rollups). Returns total_quantity and per-subscription quantity and event_count. Needs your API key.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Your account: plan, event and meter limits, event_count and first_event_at (GET /api/v1/account). Needs your API key.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_meters" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
